name: R1 One-Family, Height District 1 (BMO 2017)
source: LAMC 12.08 C (yards, encroachment plane); 12.21.1 A.1 (height); 12.03 RFA; Ord. 184,802 eff. 2017-03-17
verified: 2026-09-23 checked against LAMC 12.21.1 text (Ord. 181,624) and two secondary summaries; re-confirm 12.08 C in the current code before relying on it
notes: Front yard: 20% of lot depth, need not exceed 20 ft (prevailing setback may govern; not modeled).
Side yard: 5 ft; lots narrower than 50 ft: 10% of lot width, min 3 ft.
Height: 33 ft; 28 ft when the uppermost roof slope is under 25% (flat roof). Coastal Zone and Hillside Area not modeled.
Encroachment plane: starts 20 ft above grade at the front and side yard setback lines, slopes inward at 45 degrees.
Residential Floor Area: 0.45 x lot area (BMO). Garage exemption (200 sf/space) and 20% bonus options not modeled.
Side wall plane break (offset for long tall side walls) not modeled.
